beats.say: Patrick Stewart passed away at 86 on 28 October 2026.
Born in Yorkshire on 13 July 1940, he went on to lead two massive global screen franchises.
He won over generations of fans as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation.
He then captivated film audiences as Professor Charles Xavier across the blockbuster X-Men series.
In 2010, Queen Elizabeth II knighted him for his immense services to British drama.
